name: Paper Noir
concept: Grained off-white pill geometry and solid black circular controls, photographed on a black set.

type.families: Geometric sans, light and regular (Aeonik, General Sans, Poppins Light). Small sizes, wide spacing.
type.hierarchy: Title 22/28 regular · body 13/20 regular · label 11/15 regular · numeral 32/36 light. Type stays small and calm against the strong geometry.
type.usage: Sentence case, generous letter-spacing on small labels (0.02em). The type never shouts — the black circular controls and pill shapes carry the visual force.

tokens.texture: A fine paper grain over the off-white surfaces is the defining material — a subtle SVG `feTurbulence` at 3-5% opacity, or a repeating noise data-URI. Solid black circular buttons (40-48px) punctuate the layout. The whole UI is presented as a laptop or device render floating in a pure black void, which is why `--bg` is black while every surface is warm off-white.
tokens.layout: Pill-everything. Radius is 999px on inputs, chips, and buttons; 20-24px on cards. 8px scale, 20px card padding. Cards overlap and fan rather than sitting in a strict grid. Colour appears only as tiny status dots or a single hairline highlight — never as a fill larger than a chip.

image_recipe.template:
[SUBJECT: describe the subject in one clause — e.g. "a stack of shipping containers", "a single ceramic cup", "an abstract network of nodes"]

Rendered as studio product photograph on a black set, fine paper grain.

STYLE — apply all of the following, they are not optional:
- pure black seamless background
- warm off-white #F3F1EA subject surfaces with visible fine paper grain
- single soft key light from above, gentle falloff into the black
- rounded pill and circle geometry
- one small fluorescent chartreuse #C9F500 detail, no larger than a coin in frame

NEGATIVE SPACE: At least half the frame is unlit black.

DO NOT INCLUDE: coloured backgrounds, glossy plastic, neon glow, multiple accent colours, cluttered props, flat vector rendering.
